apparatus.crit: vāditrair vividhair gītair gandhair uccāvacair api
kaccin na mānān mohād vā kāmād vāpi
kaccij jñātīn gurūn vr̥ddhān daivatāṃs tāpasān api
caityāṃś ca vr̥kṣān kalyāṇān brāhmaṇāṃś ca
atithīn āgatān devān daityān nāgān munīṃs tathā
kaś cid āsīn mahān nr̥paḥ sa cānyaiḥ
pūjayām āsur ūcuś ca sāntvapūrvam idaṃ
kr̥ṣṇām̐l lalāmāṃś camarāñ śuklāṃś cānyāñ śaśiprabhān
kathaṃ cid; vimokṣayec cāpy asisāyakāṃś ca
citrair haimair āsanair abhyupetām; ācakhyus te
kiledaṃ; nādevanaṃ kitavair adya tair me
etad rājan dhanaṃ mahyaṃ tena dīvyāmy ahaṃ tvayā
eko me yac caitat svagataṃ dhanam
vibruvan praśnaṃ kāmāt krodhāt tathā bhayāt

apparatus.vulgate: tathāstu te mahābhāge yathā tvaṃ nandinīcchasi tṛtīyaṃ

apparatus.crit: pāṇḍavān abhyavekṣatīm hr̥tasvān bhraṣṭacittāṃs tān hr̥tadārān hr̥taśriyaḥ
